description: This file declares the interfaces and function prototypes for the System Info Repository (Sys IRO) in the BroadWay Runtime System environment. It defines functions for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the Sys IRO object, which are implemented in associated source files.

methods.name: SysCreateInfoRepository
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Info Repository object, given container and owner contexts.

methods.name: SysIroCreate
methods.description: Constructs a new Sys IRO object with specified contexts.

methods.name: SysIroRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the Sys IRO object.

methods.name: SysIroEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrols or registers nested objects within the Sys IRO.

methods.name: SysIroInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Sys IRO object with necessary configurations.
